what: The Animation Director's vision as numbers (Round 1). VISION.md is the page; this is the same thing in a form the engine and the tests can load. Starting values: every seat may argue a number on the board, nobody ignores one.
witness_note: BOLD CHOICE, one flag. true = he behaves differently when the cursor has been still for watched.gone_after_s (private bits, no cover-ups). false = he always plays to the room.

weight.feel: a sack of wet sand with a low centre: the bottom arrives first, the top follows late

tempo.feel: slow, slow, FAST, then a hold. He waits longer than is comfortable, then moves in one burst.

eyes.rule: eyes first, eyes last: they leave for the target before the body does and they finish every action

breath.note: the model's own breath is a fixed 1.2% sine at 2.86 s. Ours rides on the parent group and is never periodic.

moods.note: he is always in a BLEND of these (weights sum to 1), drifting slowly, pushed by events. A mood changes the numbers under every move (breath, blink, holds, glance rate, walk speed, spring stiffness), it does not pick clips.

unbothered.look: skeptical side-eye, long holds, slow breath

nosy.look: eyes on the cursor or the other Potato, leans toward it, drifts to window edges

smug.look: smirk, slow blinks, a small settle bounce after getting away with something

fed_up.look: sharp turns, back to you, a foot nub tapping, small glitch flickers

rattled.look: wide eyes, fast shallow breath, jitter, then pretending nothing happened

low_power.look: droop, long blinks, falls asleep standing and slides (Deep Rest, never death)

crowd.clumps: 2 + 2 + 1: there is always one odd one out, and it changes
crowd.real_one: tan (D-48); the script ones wear their own glitch colour from first-batch.json

judge.note: between two consecutive 60 Hz frames, outside tagged impact and glitch frames
judge.round2_rulings_note: Added by the Animation Director in Round 2 (BUILD-PLAN.md section 8). Nothing above was changed; these say where the numbers above do not apply and what applies instead.
judge.position_step_applies_to: keyed travel only (modes ground and clip)
judge.round3_note: Added by the Animation Director in Round 3 (NOTES-DIRECTOR.md). Nothing above was changed. The judge could fail a snap but not a statue: five minutes alone passed it with the body only breathing in 88.9% of frames.

round3_alive.note: starting marks for an unprovoked life after the quiet start; measured on draft 1 (seed 11, 5 min): travel 3.6% of frames, longest still stretch 72.8 s, places 2, own glitch 0.

stance_side_eye.note: BOLD CHOICE (Animation Director, Round 3). Design only; nothing animates it yet. When he looks at something the whole body does the side-eye, so it reads at 100 px with no face. Never a tilt toward the viewer. The rest pose is not touched. Potato seat signs a still before it runs. Off: on = false.
